info.name: On Demand Rider Authentication Proofs API
Get Proof of Pickup for Order

params.name: order_id
params.description: ID of the order to get its proof of pickup

items.docs: Use this endpoint to get proof of pickup for existing and picked up orders. __NOTE:__ Proof of pickup will be deleted after 1 week because of security and privacy concerns __NOTE:__ API returns encoded base64 file, so if you want to show that response in your html page, you should follow this element using `` *NOTE: Not yet rolled out.*
